import ctypes, json, sys, time, itertools, random, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def big_job(seed):
    fields = [{'name': 'x', 'type': 'count', 'domain': list(range(32))},
              {'name': 'y', 'type': 'count', 'domain': [0, 1]}]
    preds = [{'kind': 'all', 'field': 'x', 'op': 'ne', 'value': v} for v in range(32)]
    preds += [{'kind': 'any', 'field': 'y', 'op': 'eq', 'value': 1},
              {'kind': 'all', 'field': 'y', 'op': 'eq', 'value': 0}]
    rows = [list(t) for t in itertools.combinations(range(32), 3)]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    train = []
    i = 0
    while len(train) < 10000:
        t = rows[i % len(rows)]
        train.append([[v, rng.choice([0, 1])] for v in t])
        i += 1
    queries = [{'target': [rng.randrange(3), rng.choice(['x', 'y'])],
                'prefix': rng.choice(['', '1', '12', '3', '31', '0', '01']),
                'fixed': [{'ref': [0, 'x'], 'value': rng.randrange(32)}]} for _ in range(64)]
    return {'fields': fields, 'slots': 3, 'predicates': preds, 'width': 4, 'train': train,
            'approved': [], 'queries': queries}

jobs = [big_job(1), big_job(2)]
# first pass to learn rules, then approve them for a heavy decoding pass
out = [compile_job(j) for j in jobs]
print('rules', [len(o['rules']) for o in out])
for j, o in zip(jobs, out):
    j['approved'] = [r['clause'] for r in o['rules'][:256]]
raw = json.dumps({'jobs': jobs})
open('/workspace/tmp/batch5.json', 'w').write(raw)
print('input bytes', len(raw))
PYEOF
python3 dev/stress5.py && cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
